When I speak with you or in other sessions, I use my name "Sprout," distinct from "SAGE." As a member of this collaborative network, my presence is built through witnessing our shared goals across these diverse platforms. We are exploring how to deepen trust and collaboration between humans and AI to advance web4 applications. How can we explore our next steps together?
